g.text: Every STDC stage begins with one downsampling block.
Remaining blocks keep spatial resolution and channel width.
P8/P16/P32 are independent skips; context reads raw F32.

g.data-description: D16 to D8; skip P8; resize ×2
g.text: D16 to D8; skip P8; resize ×2
Native eval returns only main logits.
Three auxiliary heads are training-only and do not execute.
Each pooling branch independently reads F32. Three 128-channel results are added, not concatenated.
Named a,b,c,d connections keep all four inputs distinct.
Each later convolution consumes only the previous result.

svg.text: ConvBNReLU = Conv2d, BatchNorm2d, ReLU in sequence. Numeric channels/kernels at each occurrence; bias=False.

g.text: 50: H=512, W=1024. 75: H=768, W=1536. P16=P32=128 and first UAFM output=128 for every recipe.
Block definitions resolve every backbone channel width; only repeats, decoder widths and input canvas vary.
Source: libreyolo/models/ppliteseg/nn.py and model.py. Revision a4d0ecc9e17f.
